concept_base_prompt: Cannonback, the shell-sentinel water turtle creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG, the SAME character as the reference images, unchanged identity and the same clean polished stylised 3D render finish and colour palette as the clean blue turtle model renders. A massive heavy fortress snapping turtle on four thick sturdy pillar legs with big cream-ivory claws. HEAD: a HEAVY, large, blocky snapping-turtle head, broad skull and thick powerful jaw, a strong brow ridge, set on a thick muscular neck; the snout ends in a broad hooked cream-ivory beak (#eadfc4); lower face, jaw, chin and throat pale cream; upper head and brow covered in ocean-blue scales; warm amber-gold eye with dark pupil; calm, steady, stern expression. SHELL: a RUGGED shell built of STACKED NATURAL ROCK like a small mossy cliff: chunky irregular rounded boulders and thick broken stone slabs piled in overlapping layers, uneven craggy silhouette with deep shadowed cracks, slate blue-grey stone (#5f7894) with lighter grey-blue weathered edges, thick olive-green moss cushions (#6f7436) growing over the tops of the rocks and in the crevices. Not neat tiles, not bricks, not smooth turtle scutes, not flat cut slabs. CANNONS: two BIG BARREL CANNONS of weathered bronze (#a88a58 with darker verdigris-free brown patina and worn lighter rims), short and very wide, heavy rounded rim and a deep dark round bore, SEATED DEEP INTO the rock shell with boulders packed around their bases, one on each side at the front shoulders angled forward-up, and one smaller cannon at the rear top angled up. SADDLE LEDGE: between and just behind the two front cannons, the top of the shell has a clear FLAT LEVEL rock ledge, a broad flat stone platform wide and long enough for a rider to sit, with moss on it; no saddle, no rider. BODY: legs, neck, head and short tail covered in large clean deep ocean-blue scales (#2e5886) over cream skin; a CREAM-IVORY belly plastron (#e6dcc0) clearly visible under the shell rim and on the chest. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look with clean large readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal, no speckle, no noise. Neutral four-legged standing stance, all four legs clearly separated from each other and from the belly with visible gaps, head facing forward and level, short tail, full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no water, no splash, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, coral, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.

Polished stylised 3D game model, soft sculpted volumes, NOT a 2D cartoon.

generation_verdict: Identity kept (ocean-blue scales over cream skin, cream hooked beak and lower face, amber eye, cream plastron, bronze barrels, olive moss, no red). The shell is now a rugged pile of chunky rounded slate-blue boulders and broken slabs with moss on their tops instead of regen2's flat bricks; the two shoulder barrels and a small rear barrel are sunk into the rock; the head is broader and heavier; the top of the pile is a flat mossy stone ledge. The pile is tall relative to the body, so at the seat-line fit the turtle body is smaller than regen1/regen2 (length 5.94 m vs 6.16/7.41 m).
